qualifications: New claim variants are draft development gold derived from reviewed sources; not independent held-out evaluation.
The full three-system batch predates the later growth-instruction clarification. The subsequent two-case smoke is separate, never pooled.
Fault fixtures and scripted protocol tests are not real-world fault frequencies. Not-injected cases are reported separately.
The no-plan ablation disables explicit planning and automatic recovery together.
The prefetch contrast varies tool availability under common current prompts, not an exact replay of an older full implementation.
The prefetch runner marked quota_stopped on its final row, but all 24 scheduled runs exist. This status-only bug was subsequently fixed; original results are preserved.
Latencies include provider waits/retries. No user-verified prices were configured; actual billing is not measured.
Retrieval labels were pooled with keyword, TF-IDF and BM25. Any embedding/hybrid result needs additional candidate review before a final fair comparison.
Raw traces and source/PDF contents remain local and are excluded from this export.

configuration.measurement_boundary: System run includes model/tool calls, retries and query embedding; excludes initial data loading and trace serialization. Caches may be warm. Orders alternate by case/repeat.
configuration.budget_note: Same configured ceilings; baseline has a fixed two-model/two-tool pipeline. Agent may spend more within the ceilings.

summary.interruption_reason: Stopped to repair an additional-citation handoff bug and address repeated API quota failures. Do not treat this partial batch as a full-system comparison.
